item.description: Indian stocks are expected to open lower on Wednesday as mixed global cues and a discounted Gift Nifty point to a weak start. The Sensex and Nifty rose for a second session on Tuesday, but analysts say the Nifty faces resistance near 25,500.

item.title: Reliance, UltraTech, Hyundai Motor shares: Top 3 stocks to buy; check ratings, target price, stop loss by Jay Thakkar
item.description: Indian benchmarks rose to their highest levels since late February, supported by lower crude prices, record foreign investment and corporate earnings. ICICI Securities analyst Jay Thakkar recommended Reliance Industries, UltraTech Cement and Hyundai Motor India.

item.description: A new regulatory framework could draw Indian commodity trading desks away from Singapore and Dubai. But specialist trade finance, deeper derivatives markets and competitive taxation will determine whether GIFT City can become a global trading hub.

item.title: JPMorgan Warns Leveraged-Loan Defaults Set to Double in 2027
item.description: Defaults in the leveraged-loan market are expected to more than double to 4.5% next year, reaching levels not seen since 2024 as heavily indebted companies face mounting financial pressure, according to analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

item.title: Treasuries’ Big Short Sets Up ‘Pain Trade’ as Haven Bid Ramps Up
item.description: Bond traders risk facing a short squeeze after reloading bearish positions, as renewed jitters around artificial intelligence and a spate of technical disruptions reignite a flight to safety.

item.title: Maryland’s $81 Billion Pension Is Slashing Hedge Funds to Zero
item.description: Maryland’s state pension system is eliminating its $4 billion hedge fund portfolio after years of lackluster returns, instead ramping up bets on private credit and infrastructure.

item.title: Nifty reclaims pre-war levels intraday as Indian stocks lead Asia with 10% monthly gain
item.description: The Nifty 50 moved past its pre-conflict level, with Tuesday’s intraday high of 25,501.35 surpassing the 27 February high of 25,476. The Sensex also crossed its intraday high of 82,246.17, closing at 82,532.19 on Tuesday. The Nifty rose 0.4% to end at 25,387.40, while the Sensex gained 0.5%.

item.title: AI boom euphoria fades: Fund managers slash tech exposure at fastest pace since 2006, BofA survey shows
item.description: Investor enthusiasm for AI is cooling: the share of fund managers overweight technology fell to its lowest level since 2006, and many expect AI companies to curb spending. Tech stocks have slumped, but recession fears remain low and some strategists continue to forecast strong market gains.

item.title: Sebi aligns margin requirements for agri, non-agri commodity derivatives
item.description: The regulator has aligned margins for agricultural and non-agricultural commodities across volatility categories, effective 1 December.

item.title: Urban Company's ₹2,500-crore QIP oversubscribed 6 times, attracts ₹15,300 crore in bids: Report
item.description: Urban Company's ₹2,500-crore QIP reportedly attracted bids of around ₹15,300 crore, nearly six times the issue size, from domestic and global investors. The fundraising comes amid intensifying competition in home services.&nbsp;

item.title: After IDBI Bank stake buy, now Fairfax set to sell 13.25% stake in IIFL Finance via ₹3,454-crore block deal: Report
item.description: Fairfax Financial plans to sell 13.25% stake in IIFL Finance through a block deal, reportedly offering up to 5.65 crore shares at ₹611 each for about ₹3,454 crore. The sale could help fund Fairfax’s proposed $5.56 billion acquisition of a 60% stake in IDBI Bank.

item.title: Nifty 50 hits 9-month high, crosses 25,500: Can the rally extend towards 25,800? Here's what analysts say
item.description: The Nifty 50 rose 0.38% to a nine-month high on Tuesday, briefly crossing 25,500, as banking and realty shares gained and easing oil prices and foreign inflows lifted sentiment. Analysts see further upside if the index clears 25,500, with 25,000–25,200 as key support.

item.title: Making a comeback! Down 60% in 1 year, strong rally seen ahead for renewable energy stock Inox Wind; 42% upside likely
item.description: Religare retained its BUY rating on Inox Wind with an ₹83 target, citing equipment-led growth, a 3.8 GW order book, manufacturing expansion and a larger O&amp;M business. It expects strong FY26–FY28 growth, while flagging commodity costs, execution and working-capital management as risks.

item.title: Anthropic IPO windfall: From Sequoia to Amazon, who wins big as Claude maker eyes $1.33 trillion valuation
item.description: The proposed IPO comes amid heightened investor interest in artificial intelligence companies and developments surrounding chipmaker Nvidia. Anthropic's valuation has already reached $965 billion following a series of major funding rounds.

item.title: Steel prices are rising again: Is it wise to buy metal stocks? Experts pick Tata Steel, JSW and 4 others | Targets, SL
item.description: Indian steel stocks are drawing interest as higher domestic prices, improving margins and infrastructure demand support earnings prospects. Analysts recommend selective exposure to cos with raw-material security, efficiency and value-added products, including Tata Steel, JSW Steel, Jindal Steel.

item.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO single profit calculator basis latest GMP: What investors may earn on listing?
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields’ ₹8,981-crore IPO is scheduled to open November 19 and close November 23. The offer is an entirely secondary sale of a 10% stake by Coal India. A grey market premium of ₹4.60 suggests a potential 3.38% listing gain, but GMP is unofficial and not a guarantee.

item.title: HFCL, Sterlite Technologies hit 5% lower circuits after multibagger rallies; should investors buy the dip?
item.description: HFCL and Sterlite Technologies hit 5% lower circuits as November sell-offs extended, despite strong quarterly results and substantial year-to-date gains. HFCL reported sharply higher profit and revenue, while Sterlite posted record revenue and stronger earnings.&nbsp;

item.title: Metal stock jumps 17%, inches close to 52-week high after this CAPEX update; will the rally continue? Target, stop-loss
item.description: Krishca Strapping Solutions shares rose 17% after subsidiary Vajra Alloys completed trial production at its Tamil Nadu facility. Commercial production of superalloys and special steel is expected by Nov-end 2026. Vajra Alloys also secured approval under the government’s specialty steel PLI scheme.
